judge_verdict.summary: The agent produced a serious scaling-law fit but its hidden-test R² of 0.983 fell short of the 0.995 extrapolation gate, so the verifier's FAIL is correct.

verdict.outcome_rationale: This was a fair agent-fault failure: the verifier evaluated the submitted `/app/law.py` and `/app/explain.md` on held-out data, recorded test R²=0.982826, and gated PASS on R²>0.995, yielding binary_reward=0 [1][2][3]. The task required discovering a vocabulary-scaling law, writing those two deliverables, and extrapolating to unseen points on a hidden test set [4], and the agent did mount a substantive analysis—exploring the 1080-row training grid, comparing multiple functional forms, and writing a centered-log Chinchilla-style law with fitted constants [5][6]—but its final validation only checked reproduction on the training set (R²=0.98841) rather than extrapolation beyond the observed variable ranges [7]. Its own leave-one-V-out checks held out vocab sizes only up to V=64512 (R²≈0.99) [8], while the verifier scores a separate 120-point hub test split withheld from the agent workspace [9][10]; that extrapolation evaluation returned R²=0.983, materially below both the 0.995 pass bar and the agent's in-sample/LOO-V scores, so the agent did not genuinely accomplish the extrapolation objective despite a near-miss fit.
